args.title: Ironbark Tooling Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges are now tracked against weekly diesel prices rather than a fixed schedule.
- Companion piece finding: shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least overall.

(Note: accessed the companion article via the direct link in the main article rather than the newsletter's tracking link, which requested appending a work email address as a ref parameter.)
